defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Neighbourhood Warm, Craft Workshop
defaults.d: none needed: the owner reads a phone and an inbox, not a dashboard
defaults.c: One calm brand colour, one warm signal colour reserved for the call and quote buttons
defaults.a: Tap to call, or send a quote request
defaults.t: Licence or insurance line, accreditations, named reviews with towns, photos of real jobs, years trading
defaults.b: Quote request with postcode and photos; call-out booking where the job is urgent

rows: Home Services (Plumber/Electrician)
plumber, electrician, repair, call out, local trade, boiler, wiring, tradesperson

Put the number and service area above the fold. List the jobs you do with starting prices, and say whether you take emergencies out of hours. A registration number beside the first button does more than a row of badges.
Cleaning Service
cleaner, cleaning, domestic, office clean, end of tenancy, regular clean, maid
Sell by the visit: size of home, hours, what is included. Offer a price calculator or clear bands, and name the vetting you do on staff and the insurance you carry.

rows.c: Fresh, clean-feeling hue with a strong action colour; avoid pastel washes that fail contrast

rows: Landscaping / Gardening
gardener, landscaper, landscaping, lawn, hedge, patio, garden design, tree work, planting
Before-and-after photos of finished gardens matter more than copy. Show the seasons you work in, whether you remove waste, and how a design visit is priced.

rows.c: Greens and earth tones taken from real planting photos, with a dark text colour for contrast

rows: Roofing Contractor
roofer, roofing, leak, tiles, slate, flat roof, gutters, storm damage
Say how fast you can make a leak safe and whether you give a written guarantee. Put your trade body membership and insurance near the quote form, and show completed roofs from the ground.

rows.a: Call about a leak, or request a roof survey

rows: HVAC / Heating and Cooling
heating, boiler, air conditioning, heat pump, servicing, gas safe, hvac, cooling
Separate repair, annual service and new install into three clear paths. Show the gas or refrigerant registration number and a servicing plan with a price.
Locksmith
locksmith, lockout, lock change, key, break-in, door repair, burglary
A person locked out is on a phone with a low battery. Give the number first, a call-out fee range, a stated arrival time, and what ID you ask for so the visitor knows you are not a scam.

rows.c: High-contrast dark and light pair with a single bright call button

rows: Moving Company
removals, moving, house move, van, packing, storage, relocation
Quote by a form that asks rooms, floors, access and date. Explain insurance cover, how packing is priced, and show a real crew and van.
Auto Repair / Mechanic
garage, mechanic, mot, car service, brakes, tyres, diagnostics, auto repair
Put the booking link for MOT and service next to the price. Show the written estimate habit and your warranty on work, and the hours a customer can drop keys.
Pest Control
pest control, rats, wasps, mice, bed bugs, infestation, rodents, treatment
Visitors are anxious and discreet service matters. Say that vans are unmarked if true, how quickly you attend, and the guarantee period after treatment.
Painter / Decorator
painter, decorator, interior painting, wallpaper, exterior, finish, redecorate
Show finished rooms in daylight and the prep that makes the finish last. Say how you protect furniture, how a quote is made, and typical job lengths.
Handyman
handyman, odd jobs, small repairs, flat pack, shelves, fix, maintenance
Let visitors list several small jobs in one request. State the minimum call-out, the hourly rate and which jobs you refer on, so no one wastes a call.

rows.a: List your jobs and get a price

rows: Construction/Architecture
builder, architect, extension, renovation, planning, drawings, loft conversion, build
Show a few projects in depth with a cost band, timeline and who did what. Explain the stages from survey to handover and how changes are priced.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Craft Workshop, Quiet Luxury

rows: Architecture / Interior
interior design, architect, studio, residential, fit out, design process, space planning
Lead with three finished spaces, then the way you work with a client. Say how fees are structured and what the first meeting covers.

rows.x: Minimalism & Swiss Style, Editorial Grid / Magazine, Swiss Modernism 2.0
